name: snowy-bridge
description: Snow, Lamp, Bridge: a silent PS1-style three.js scene exported as MP4 and a self-contained HTML file

scripts.check: npm run check:forbidden && npm run build && npm run check:determinism && npm run check:cameras
scripts.export: npm run build && node scripts/sound.js && node scripts/capture.js --profile full --audio out/sound.wav
scripts.export:4k: npm run build && node scripts/sound.js && node scripts/capture.js --profile 4k --audio out/sound.wav
